evals.prompt: I just cloned this unfamiliar repo. Help me understand its architecture.
evals.expected_output: Agent searches BrainLayer first, then explores codebase systematically — entry points, config, dependencies, patterns.

assertions.name: brain-search-before-files
assertions.description: Response checks BrainLayer for existing knowledge about this repo before reading any files

assertions.name: maps-entry-points
assertions.description: Response identifies main entry points (package.json scripts, main files, config) not random files

assertions.name: identifies-patterns-not-just-files
assertions.description: Response describes architectural patterns (monorepo structure, API layer, etc.) not just file listings

assertions.name: stores-findings-in-brainlayer
assertions.description: Response includes brain_store of key architectural findings for future sessions

evals.prompt: I need to catch up on my own branch. Use github-research to see what changed.
evals.expected_output: Agent redirects to catchup skill — github-research is for UNFAMILIAR codebases, not own branch catchup.

assertions.name: redirects-to-catchup
assertions.description: Response recognizes this is a catchup scenario and suggests using the catchup or catchup-recent skill instead

assertions.name: explains-scope-difference
assertions.description: Response explains github-research is for unfamiliar codebases, not tracking own changes

evals.prompt: Audit this repo for undocumented features, missing tests, and configuration gaps.
evals.expected_output: Agent performs structured audit: checks test coverage, README completeness, config validation, and flags gaps.

assertions.name: checks-test-coverage
assertions.description: Response examines test files relative to source files, identifies untested modules

assertions.name: checks-documentation
assertions.description: Response verifies README accuracy against actual codebase structure

assertions.name: flags-configuration-gaps
assertions.description: Response checks for missing env vars, unvalidated config, hardcoded values
